headline: Quiet day before the storm; scores barely move
body: A quiet day with no scored events. Scores drifted by hundredths as earlier news faded: Protector God, Enslaved God and Descendants eased while 1984 and Reversion edged up. Horizon Balance is 2.8, down 0.01.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Protector God -0.05 and Enslaved God -0.05.
